title: Her book
summary: The reporter is writing a book about the club, a hundred years of it, and she wants a chapter about you. She wants the true version of one night you've never talked about.

ends.title: The chapter
ends.text: There's a chapter about you in her book. It's the one people read first, and it's true.

ends.title: The footnote
ends.text: You're a footnote in her book. She was kind about it.

beats.title: A chapter

event.title: A chapter
event.speaker: reporter
setup: {reporter.short} has a dictaphone, a real one this time, and a list of questions in very small writing. A hundred years of the club, and a chapter about you.

say: "I want the night you nearly left. The real one. Not the press-office one."

replies.label: Tell her some, and ask her to leave the rest.

tell.text: Two hours. She stops the tape once, to let you get a drink of water.

some.text: She crosses things out while you watch, so you know.

other.text: She writes about the lads, and puts you in the corner of one photo.

beats.hint: The reporter wants a chapter about you in her book

beats.title: The launch

event.title: The launch
event.speaker: reporter
setup: A season on. The launch is in the bookshop by the station. There's a queue out of the door, and a lot of them are holding the book open at your chapter.

choices.label: Go and sign them with her.

outcomes.text: You sign three hundred books next to her. Somebody asks you to sign the photo of the night you nearly left.
You sign the corner of a photo. She was kind about it.
She puts the flowers by the till and tells the queue you're shy.
She puts the flowers by the till.

beats.hint: A season on, her book comes out
